title: Summability of the even binomial series
statement: For real numbers $s$ and $x$ with $|x|<1$, the series $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{s}{2k}x^{2k}$, with generalized binomial coefficients, is summable.
replaced: For every $s,x\in\bbr$ with $|x|<1$, the series $\sum_{k=0}^{\infty}\binom{s}{2k}x^{2k}$ is summable, with generalized binomial coefficients.
